verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Finix provides separate Sandbox and Live accounts with corresponding API credentials. That is environment separation, an adjacent feature, not the ability to issue scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Nothing documents permission scopes, restricted keys, or per-agent credential limits, and the Finix MCP server is described only for asking documentation questions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
